messages:
Sam: Morning — nightly CI flagged a regression on small-batch p95 for orbit-run-7, +18% vs baseline. bench dashboard: https://bench.redwood/exp/orbit-run-7
Rae: ugh, saw that metric. any obvious diffs in config?
Devon: grabbing the logs now. which test variant? small-batch-16?
Sam: yes small-batch-16, seq_len 512, model: redwood-v2-7b-quant. Runner: gpu-pool-3
bench-bot: ALERT at 2026-03-18T03:12:05Z — p95 increased 18% (baseline 120ms -> 142ms). Sample trace id: trace-5170000000-a
Mira: pinging to see if the nightly had kernel updates on that pool. @ops-bot any infra changes last night?
ops-bot: No kernel updates deployed to gpu-pool-3 in the 12h window. Autoscaler spun up 2 nodes at 02:48 for burst, then drained. No known runtime upgrades.
Devon: logs pulled: attaching top stack snippet — looks like repeated mutex wait in batcher thread
Devon: ```
00:12:03.412 batcher.cpp:243 wait_for_batch() took 18ms
00:12:03.430 batcher.cpp:256 assemble_batch() took 14ms
00:12:03.446 kv_cache.cpp:87 lock_acquire() took 20ms
```
Rae: that kv_cache lock delay smells like eviction churn. Any recent changes to prefix caching or eviction policy?
Sam: We did flip a flag in latest staging: `kvcache.eviction_threshold=0.67` -> `0.5` in the rollout two days ago but it was not supposed to hit prod. Need to confirm if rollout touched dedicated pools.
Mira: checking rollout logs... aha: rollout `prefetch-2026-03-16` accidentally included gpu-pool-3 via label mismatch. Marking rollback candidate.
Devon: quick repro plan: run `bench run --suite=nightly --filter=small-batch-16 --trace=trace-5170000000-a --env=staging` and attach perf profile. Whoever can kick that?
Rae: I can run it in 15m. Will also run with `KVCACHE_EVICT=0.8` and `0.5` to compare.
Sam: great. if repro matches, let's rollback `prefetch-2026-03-16` from gpu-pool-3 and rerun the nightly. If not, we'll bisect further.
bench-bot: CI run queued: nightly-small-batch-16 #5170000001 (owner Rae). Link: https://ci.redwood/runs/5170000001
Devon: note: capture `perf record -g` and set `RW_BENCH_VERBOSE=1` so we get the callgraph.
Mira: I'll prepare the rollback PR and tag oncall for approval. scheduling a quick sync at 03:45 UTC if needed.
Sam: thanks all. keep live updates here; short term: repro -> config toggle -> rollback if confirmed. :thumbsup:
Rae: starting run now, will post results in ~10m.
Devon: if repro fails, will kick off a small-batch run across pool-5 for comparison.
Rae: run finished: p95 still elevated in staging with prefetch flag at 0.5. With KVCACHE_EVICT=0.8 p95 drops back to baseline. attaching csv: https://bench.redwood/artifacts/5170000001/results.csv
Sam: confirms hypothesis. Mira please rollback.
Mira: rollback PR opened: https://git.redwood/infra/rollouts/1234 — rolling back prefetch-2026-03-16 from gpu-pool-3. will monitor.
ops-bot: rollback applied to pool gpu-pool-3 at 03:37 UTC.
bench-bot: rerun of nightly-small-batch-16 queued #5170000002.
Rae: rerun p95 back to baseline after rollback. closing the alert.
Sam: nice work. we'll add a guard to rollout label resolution and an automated post-rollout perf smoke for small-batch. Filing followup ticket.
Devon: ticket created: INFRA-9272 — rollout label guard + post-rollout perf smoke. assigning to Mira + infra.
Mira: on it. Closing thread after postmortem notes are drafted.
Sam: closing notes: root cause = incorrect rollout label causing kv cache eviction threshold change on gpu-pool-3, symptom = mutex waits in batcher, mitigation = rollback + add automation. :white_check_mark:
